The Comedy Festival with Cute Abiola is set to expand beyond Nigeria, with London announced as the next destination for the event in March 2027. The development follows successful editions held in Ilorin, Kwara State, on July 11, 2026, and Ibadan, Oyo State, on September 27, 2026. The festival, produced by Ashipa Network and packaged by Khapy of Lagos, has attracted personalities from the comedy, music, filmmaking, streaming and digital content industries, positioning it as a growing platform for entertainment and cultural engagement. Speaking on the planned expansion, Director of Ashipa Network, Kolawole Ashipa, said the success of the Ibadan edition motivated the decision to take the production to the United Kingdom. He, however, clarified that the international expansion would not affect the festival’s planned tour of Nigerian cities, revealing that preparations were underway for editions in Osun, Ogun and Abuja. While we continue our expansion across Nigeria, we also believe Nigerians in the diaspora deserve to experience what we are building back home,” Ashipa said. He added that taking the festival to London would provide an opportunity to showcase Nigerian entertainment and creativity to a wider international audience. Meanwhile, comedian Cute Abiola expressed appreciation to the Oyo State Government for its support and presence at the Ibadan edition. 2027: APC leaders rally South-West support for Tinubu Tinubu woos Yutong, targets 40% fare cut NIQS, Kwara seek rent subsidy as housing deficit hits 15 million He also acknowledged the contributions of celebrities, partners and other entertainment industry stakeholders who supported the event. The previous editions featured more than 30 entertainment personalities each, including streamers Carter Efe, Peller and Trinity; musicians Skibii, Shoday, Rybeena, Segun Johnson and Danny S; as well as actors Femi Adebayo, Eniola Ajao, Kemity and Yemi Elesho. Others included content creators Taaooma, Kidbaby, Kamo State and Ozain, alongside comedians Kenny Blaq, Baba Kamo, Alariya and Yunusa. The organisers said the London edition was expected to create opportunities for corporate brands, investors and strategic partners while introducing the festival to Nigerians in the diaspora and other lovers of African entertainment in the United Kingdom. For Ashipa Network and its packaging partner, Khapy of Lagos, the expansion represents an effort to build a sustainable entertainment brand that connects cities, promotes Nigerian creativity and creates opportunities within the global entertainment industry. The organisers maintained that the festival would continue its Nigerian tour alongside its international expansion, with London scheduled as its next destination in March 2027.
